system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "I want to stop my monthly payments to you because I recently bought a car and I need to save my money for payments for that. Also I dislike how have I to air my problems this way."
Intent: billing_subscription (Cannot pay current subscription due to car purchase (money and plan problems).)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: DM for account details so billing can be checked; pure pricing / offer-terms questions can be answered publicly.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: billing_or_refund; billing/plan issue that needs the customer's account (triage says the account must be checked)). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "I want to cancel whatever I am paying 9.99 a month for. I have no account apparently, so I can't cancel it! Free thru Toyota for a month maybe? Stop billing me."
   SpotifyCares: "1: Hey! Help's here. Can you DM us a screenshot of the charge as it appears on your bank statement? For security reasons, we'd advise to... [LINK]"
2. Customer: "click on the "change payment" button. I don't want my subscription to go away! Please help!"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Claire, help's here. Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll check it out for you /MG [LINK]"
3. Customer: "please help me cancel my payments for an account I do not have access to. Also get a customer service number if you won’t help"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Brandon! We've already sent a response to you via DM. Let's continue chatting there 🙂"
4. Customer: "I have 2 payments coming out to you. I don't know the account sign ins and want to cancel the accounts. How do I do this?"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there! Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll take a look backstage /RB [LINK]"
5. Customer: "need to cancel my payments but cant sign in"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey! We've just sent you a bit more info over DM. We'll carry on helping out there"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
response: Hey there! I understand you're having trouble with your subscription. Can you DM us your account's username or email address so we can check it out? We'll take a look backstage to help you out.
